title: Engine-starting overlay renders its backdrop UNDER an open Flow
description: MpiStartingComfy portals its backdrop+wrapper to body with the CSS fallback z (10009/10010), but an open Flow is a main-area MpiOverlay at the Overlays queue z (>=10010), so the Flow paints over the dark backdrop while the gallery behind is dimmed. Fix: same --main-overlay-z floor MpiModal uses.
